item.title: List of speakers released for 2026 Bridge Crossing Jubilee in Selma
item.description: Organizers of the annual Bridge Crossing Jubilee in Selma have released the list of people who will be speaking this year, as the event also will pay tribute to the life of Rev. Jesse Jackson.

item.title: Two juveniles charged with kidnapping, robbery in Montgomery
item.description: Action 8 News has confirmed that two juvenile males have been charged with kidnapping and robbery in a case that happened on Atlanta Highway.

item.title: PHOTOS: Upgrades coming to Riverwalk Stadium for 2026 Montgomery Biscuits season
item.description: Baseball fans will find a lot of exciting upgrades at Riverwalk Stadium when the Montgomery Biscuits start the 2026 season.

item.title: President Trump has options after U.S. Supreme Court strikes down his tariffs
item.description: President Trump still has options to keep taxing imports aggressively even after the Supreme Court struck down the tariffs he imposed last year on nearly every country on earth.

item.title: Showers Friday, some storms Saturday, winter cold returns Sunday
item.description: Scattered showers and some storms re-develop along the stalled front Saturday morning. The front picks up forward speed by the afternoon, sending showers and storms south. A few storms may become strong to severe, mainly south of highway 80 and Interstate 85.

item.title: Rain & Storms Saturday Then Turning Colder Sunday
item.description: Strong to severe storms are possible Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Alabama Kidney Foundation holds kickoff for annual Kidney Walk
item.description: The Alabama Kidney Foundation has held a kickoff for its annual Kidney Walk and Celebration.

item.title: Milo’s Hamburgers closes Montgomery location
item.description: Birmingham-based Milo's Hamburgers has announced the closing of its location at EastChase in Montgomery.

item.title: 18-year-old charged with making terrorist threat against high school in Lee County
item.description: The Lee County Sheriff's Office says an 18-year-old has been arrested and charged with making a threat against Smith Station High School.

item.title: Notasulga man charged with child sex abuse, child pornography possession
item.description: A Notasulga man faces a list of charges, including child sex abuse and other sex-related offenses.
